title: AI PM Learning Roadmap
summary: The article presents a structured self-learning roadmap for aspiring AI Product Managers, organized into nine sections covering skills from prompt engineering to career resources. It argues that AI PM is a subset of traditional PM but requires deeper technical knowledge, heavier use of AI tools, and familiarity with concepts like RAG, evals, and agent workflows. The author positions this free roadmap as superior to paid courses costing up to $2,000.
key_claims: AI PM is a subset of traditional PM, not an entirely separate discipline, but requires greater technical depth and AI tool usage.
Prompt engineering is described as the number one skill for building great AI agents and improving productivity.
RAG should be used when retrieving specific knowledge or documents, while fine-tuning is reserved for specialized domains with consistent style or format needs.
Common mistakes when building AI products include having no fallback strategy, ignoring latency and cost, building without evaluations, and overfitting to demos.
Breaking into AI PM requires building a portfolio, updating a resume and LinkedIn, obtaining referrals, and being prepared for unique interview formats including vibe coding and AI ethics questions.
